result:
I didn't change any code, because the app already works this way. Running history and Delete account were both already hidden on the first-time profile page, and I told you so when I added each one. I tested this on a temporary copy of the project, and the real database and the login and signup templates are untouched.

| Situation | Page shown | Running history and Delete account |
|---|---|---|
| Right after signup | "A few quick questions" | Hidden |
| Opening the profile again before finishing it | "A few quick questions" | Hidden |
| Submitting the form with errors, even with some answers valid | "A few quick questions" with the errors | Hidden |
| Logging out and back in before finishing | "A few quick questions" | Hidden |
| After the profile is saved | "Your profile" | Shown |
| Saved profile, then a failed save | "Your profile" with the errors | Shown |

**If you're seeing them on the first-time page,** these are the likeliest reasons:
- **The account already has a saved profile.** It then gets the normal "Your profile" page. To see the first-time page, sign up with a new username.
- **The page is out of date.** A server started before these changes, or an old copy of the page in your browser, could show something different. Restart `python app.py` and do a hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R).
- **The app is running from a different folder.** The `feature_build` version has its own templates, and I only changed `engineering_build`.

If it still happens after that, tell me the steps you took or send a screenshot, and I'll look into it.
